source: k=6 English-only clustering of 4860 AmazonHelp messages (sentence-transformers 384d) + human naming/merging; 3% URL-noise cluster deleted; non-English clusters excluded by construction. Draft: data/sample/taxonomy_draft.json
priority_rule: refund_return > missing_parcel_tracking > device_app_account > delivery_delay > order_status_general > other_unclear

intents.name: delivery_delay
intents.definition: Order is late, delayed past the promised/Prime date, delivery rescheduled, or a delivery attempt failed. The parcel is NOT claimed delivered.
examples: Hi - another Amazon prime delivery hasn't arrived when it was meant to. Please advise
Pathetic..Again ur delivery is delayed and this tym it is not even half way mark
confusing_neighbors: missing_parcel_tracking (late vs lost share vocabulary; fake attempts are delay, delivered-claims are missing)

intents.name: missing_parcel_tracking
intents.definition: Marked delivered/handed over but not received; tracking stuck, lost, stolen, or carrier investigation needed. A delivered-claim must be present.
examples: I ordered pigeon gas stove updated it delivered but I haven't received it yet
So claims that I was handed my delivery today, I wasn't even in the house and there's no parcel
confusing_neighbors: delivery_delay (see above; 8+ golden disagreements lived here)

intents.name: refund_return
intents.definition: Refund, return, replacement, wrong/damaged item, double/unauthorized charge, cashback or compensation owed.
exclude: order-status questions with no money claim (order_status_general)
examples: poor refund process. not yet received refund after 20 days
I was charged twice for my subscription this month
confusing_neighbors: order_status_general (cancelled orders without money claims stay status)

intents.name: device_app_account
intents.definition: Alexa/Echo/Fire/Kindle/app/device setup or failure, account linking/login, Prime-service access, or support-contact requests tied to a device/account issue.
exclude: order or delivery problems that merely mention the app (route by the problem, not the word 'app')
examples: I cannot own any Alexa device because it won't link to my account
Why would Belgian customers pay for Prime Video if we cannot order the Fire TV Stick
confusing_neighbors: order_status_general ('called customer care 20 times' is status/complaint, not device)

intents.name: order_status_general
intents.definition: Generic where-is-my-order / status / cancellation / address-change requests with an order number and no specific delay, loss, or money claim yet.
exclude: anything with a delay, delivered-claim, or money claim (route to those)
examples: Billing address is same as Shipping address. Could you please check I'm not able to change
Please let me know the status of my order number (#408-2655073-8313954).
confusing_neighbors: delivery_delay, refund_return (thin class, n=11 in golden; merge candidate if it stays unmeasurable)

intents.name: other_unclear
intents.definition: Rejection bucket: does not fit a defined intent, non-English slip-through, fragment with no actionable issue, or pure feedback with no request. ALWAYS escalates; scored as detection recall, not a normal F1 class.
exclude: anything actionable (if in doubt, pick the closest operational intent and escalate on uncertainty instead)
examples: One was shipped via AMZL US and the other UPS.

escalate_when: model_score or similarity below tuned thresholds
